# Event sheet 1
# Source: eventSheets/Event sheet 1.json

global var score: number = 0

group "GameLoop" (active)
  block
    when: System.on-start-of-layout()
    do: Functions.map-function-default(name="mymap", function=MyFunction)
    do: Functions.map-function-default(name="normal", function=MyFunction)

  var temp: number = 0

  block
    when: NavButton.on-clicked()
    when: System.compare-two-values(first-value=score, comparison=4 (>), second-value=0)
    when: System.compare-eventvar(variable=temp, comparison=0 (=), value=0)
    do: ace NavButton.OnClickAction()

  function MyFunction() -> number [category: sample]
    do: Functions.set-function-return-value(value=1)

  async function MyAsyncFunction(timer: string = test, duration: number = 1) -> none [copy-picked] [category: async sample] -- A sample async function
    do: Sprite2[MyCustomBehavior].stop()
    do: TextFamily[Timer].start-timer(duration=duration, type=once, tag=timer)
    do: System.wait-for-previous-actions()

  ace NavButton.OnClickAction() -> none [copy-picked] [category: custom] -- Action to be call on clicked
    do: System.add-to-eventvar(variable=temp, value=Functions.CallMapped("mymap", "MyFunction") + Functions.MyFunction)
    do: call MyAsyncFunction("test", 1)
    do: System.wait-for-previous-actions()
    do: System.go-to-layout(layout=Second Layout)
